## Frequently asked questions

### Where is VRSI Multi Speciality Hospital?
No. 189, Muthukrishnan Street, Bhuvneshwari Nagar, 1st Main Road Extn, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does VRSI Multi Speciality Hospital have?
Neuro surgery, General medicine, General surgery, Orthopedics, Ophthalmology, Surgical oncology, Surgical gastroenterology, Dentistry, Vascular surgery, Accident & trauma, Intensive care unit, Health checks, Diabetes clinic, Women's clinic, Bone & joint clinic, Wound management.

### Is the hospital open at night?
Yes. VRSI offers 24/7 emergency care, with accident and trauma care and an intensive care unit.

### Which specialities are available?
Neuro surgery, general medicine, general surgery, orthopedics, ophthalmology, surgical oncology, surgical gastroenterology, dentistry and vascular surgery.

### How do I get an appointment at VRSI Multi Speciality Hospital?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 72001 03018.
